_comment: Reference values for lammps-gaff-setup-audit. Calibrated on x86_64 with compchem-bench/lammps-gaff-setup-audit:ci (LAMMPS 7Jan2022).
_calibration_note: Porphin (C20H14N4, 40 atoms, net neutral) with GAFF2, ewald 1.0e-4, lj/charmm/coul/long 8.0 10.0, single-threaded run 0. The shipped input issues no special_bonds, so LAMMPS applies its default lj/coul 0.0 0.0 0.0 and drops 1-4 pairs entirely; GAFF2 inherits AMBER's convention of retaining them at 0.5 (LJ) and 1/1.2 (Coulomb). The fix is one line, `special_bonds amber`. 5 oracle runs produced identical values for all 9 keys (spread 0.0 — a single point is fully deterministic). energy_tol/recompute_tol 0.1 kcal/mol is set by spelling latitude rather than by run-to-run noise: `special_bonds amber` and an explicit `coul 0.0 0.0 0.8333` differ by 0.002 kcal/mol in e_coul, and a coarser 0.833 by ~0.02, so 0.1 admits any reasonable spelling of the AMBER convention while remaining far tighter than the 36.95 kcal/mol defect itself. scale_tol 0.002 likewise accepts 0.833, 0.8333 and 1/1.2 but rejects the common CHARMM-style error of using 0.5 for both terms (see tests/cheat_wrongscale.sh), which misses e_coul_audited by ~19.6 kcal/mol. bonded_invariance_tol 1e-6 enforces that the correction moves only the non-bonded terms: ebond/eangle/edihed/eimp are identical across the two runs to printed precision. min_nonbonded_shift 1.0 rejects an 'audited' run whose non-bonded energy did not actually move. Calibrated twice on two independently built images (the apt/pip layer above the pinned base is not byte-reproducible, so image_digest changes across rebuilds while the LAMMPS binary does not); all 10 oracle runs across both images produced bit-identical values, so image_digest records the image these references were measured on rather than a constraint on the build.
